A Jedi Academy instructor is studying which learning habits are associated with Padawans' scores on a 120-point practice exam. Each row represents one Padawan. 

### Variables

| Variable | Meaning | Type / units |
|---|---|---|
| `padawan_id` | Anonymous row identifier | ID; do not use as a predictor |
| `exam_score_points` | Practice exam score (out of 120) | Continuous, points |
| `study_hours` | Hours spent studying in the prior week | Continuous, hours |
| `practice_questions` | Practice questions completed | Count |
| `hint_requests` | Hints requested during practice | Count |
| `sleep_hours` | Average nightly sleep during the prior week | Continuous, hours/night |
| `attendance_pct` | Academy classes attended | Continuous, percent |
| `study_group` | Participated in a study group | Binary: 0 = no, 1 = yes |



Let's call in the packages and data we need,

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ssstats)

jedi <- read_csv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/samanthaseals/STA4173Fa26/refs/heads/main/workshops/data/M4-jedi-training.csv")
```
